_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The file editor recovers unsaved edits when switching files after a failed save. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} runs in a directory holding first.md ("# First") and second.md ("# Second"). Every save of first.md (POST /api/write-file) fails with status 503 until call "allow writes"; call "first.md" returns first.md's contents on disk, JSON-encoded; call "first.md has Keep me" says whether first.md on disk contains "Keep me" ("true" or "false"). To "open F": press "p" (lowercase) with the Control modifier (on whatever has focus); wait for the finder input ".grp-filter" to be visible; fill it with F; wait for the FIRST ".grp-row" to contain F (assert_text_contains on ".grp-row", which checks the first match: the finder lists every file until the query applies, and Enter opens the top row, so waiting for any row with the text is not enough); press Enter in the finder input; the dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name matches the regular expression /Edit .*F/ is then "the modal" for F, and its ".monaco-editor" should become visible (up to 15s). "The preview" is the modal's region (role "region") named "Markdown preview". "The editor input" is the modal's ".monaco-editor textarea.inputarea"; to focus it, eval its focus(). Key presses go to whatever has focus; do not click anything to focus first unless a step says so. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. Open first.md. 3. Focus the editor input. 4. Press "End" with the Control modifier. 5. Type, key by key, "\n## Keep me" (the \n presses Enter). 6. Open second.md. 7. Open first.md again ("the reopened modal"). 8. The reopened modal's ".view-lines" should contain "Keep me". 9. Its ".agents-md-save-error" should be visible. 10. Call "first.md": it must return exactly "\"# First\\n\"" (nothing saved). 11. Call "allow writes". 12. Focus the reopened modal's editor input. 13. Press "s" (lowercase) with the Control modifier. 14. Call "first.md has Keep me" until it returns "true".
